text: DSH VS Code Connect（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：把 DSH 桌面端连接到 VS Code 配套扩展，让用户在编辑器中继续同一工作区和会话。插件在 DSH 设置界面提供连接状态、启停开关和复制连接地址；本机连接桥接 DSH API，Windows 同机环境可自动发现，其他环境可手动粘贴连接地址。适合希望在 VS Code 中接续桌面端 DSH 编程会话的用户。需要同时运行 DSH Desktop 与配套扩展，不需要额外 API Key。

DSH VS Code Connect links DSH Desktop to its companion extension, letting you continue the same workspace and conversation in VS Code. Its settings panel shows status and copies a connection address. Windows supports local discovery; elsewhere, connect manually. Both apps are required.
想在 VS Code 里接着用 DSH 桌面端当前的工作区和会话。
怎么把 VS Code 编辑器连到正在运行的 DSH Desktop？
希望 Windows 上的 DSH 和 VS Code 能在同一台电脑自动连接。
DSH VS Code Connect 的功能「继续桌面会话」：配套扩展连接到 DSH Desktop 后，可选取同一工作区和已有会话，在 VS Code 中继续工作。桌面端设置面板可复制连接地址，供扩展手动连接。
DSH VS Code Connect 的功能「本机自动发现」：Windows 同机运行时，插件通过配对服务发布本机连接信息，配套扩展可自动找到桌面端；设置开关关闭时停止自动发现。
DSH VS Code Connect 使用前须知：手动复制的连接地址含连接凭据，应只粘贴到配套的 VS Code 扩展；配对信息由 DSH credentials 存储接口保存。

dsh-vscode-connect README · DSH VS Code Connect：简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

让 DeepSeek Harness / DSH Desktop 与配套的 [DSH Coding Agent](https://github.com/mcdottok/vscode-dsh) 扩展连接，在编辑器中接续同一会话，提供类似 Codex、Claude Code 的 VS Code 插件体验。

dsh-vscode-connect README · 演示：[](docs/assets/demo.mp4)

[查看演示视频](docs/assets/demo.mp4)

dsh-vscode-connect README · 安装即连接：连接需要两端配合：**本插件安装在 DeepSeek Harness / DSH Desktop 中，配套扩展安装在 VS Code 中**。

在 **DeepSeek Harness / DSH Desktop → 插件 → 添加插件** 中填写下面的包名，点击「安装」即可，无需先下载文件：

```text
dsh-vscode-connect@latest
```

1. 安装后启用插件并保持桌面端运行。首次安装默认开启 **VS Code 连接**。
2. DSH Coding Agent 暂时被 VS Code 扩展商城下架（具体原因尚未明确），等待后续重新上架。期间请从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mcdottok/vscode-dsh/releases) 下载 `.vsix`，在 VS Code 中选择 **扩展：从 VSIX 安装...** 并选中下载的文件。打开并信任项目文件夹，在扩展连接设置中选择 **DSH Desktop**。
3. Windows 同机环境下自动发现并连接；选择同一工作区和已有会话，即可继续开发。

dsh-vscode-connect README · 安装即连接：也可在下载 VSIX 后，在文件所在目录通过命令行安装（将文件名替换为实际下载的版本）：

```powershell
code --install-extension ./dsh-coding-agent-0.1.83.vsix
```

扩展源码与问题反馈见 [vscode-dsh GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/mcdottok/vscode-dsh)。

无需开启桌面端浏览器访问，也无需切换桌面布局。曾手动关闭连接的设置会保留，可在 **设置 → 通用设置 → VS Code 连接** 重新开启。

插件已发布到 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-vscode-connect)。也可从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mcdottok/dsh-vscode-connect/releases) 下载 `.tgz`，通过本地文件安装。若镜像源暂时找不到包，可切换官方 npm 源重试。

dsh-vscode-connect README · 命令行安装（从 npm 获取）：如果使用 DSH Web / CLI，可执行：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-vscode-connect@latest
```

如果操作桌面端的 `desktop` profile，使用**该桌面端自带的 DSH CLI** 执行：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-vscode-connect@latest
```

操作 `desktop` profile 时，`dsh` 应指向目标桌面端随附的 CLI，不要用其他版本的全局 DSH 命令修改桌面端 profile。桌面用户也可以直接使用前面的「添加插件」入口。

包由 npm 提供，`dsh plugin` 负责安装到对应 profile 并注册插件。
section: 命令行安装（从 npm 获取）

text:
dsh-vscode-connect README · 连接说明：- 本插件是 **桌面端的连接配套插件**，需要与 VS Code 中的 **DSH Coding Agent** 一起使用。
- 连接入口显示「已就绪」表示桌面端可以接受连接；是否已经连接，请查看 VS Code 扩展中的状态。
- 如果 VS Code 使用本机 npm 安装的 `dsh` 包运行独立服务，无需安装本插件。独立实例与桌面端同时打开同一会话时，可能因会话占用而无法修改模型或发送消息；请在另一实例中释放该会话、使用新会话，或改为连接原桌面端。同一工作区中的不同会话不受这一限制。

dsh-vscode-connect README · 手动连接与管理：其他平台、远程环境或自动连接不可用时，在桌面端 **设置 → 通用设置 → VS Code 连接** 中点击 **复制连接地址**，然后在 VS Code 执行 **DSH: Connect to Desktop / 连接桌面端** 并粘贴地址。已有手动配置优先于自动发现。若无法恢复连接，确认桌面端及两端插件正在运行、连接开关已开启，再复制最新地址重新连接。

连接地址含凭据，请勿分享。自动连接当前仅支持 Windows 本机，凭据由 Windows 账户加密与 VS Code SecretStorage 保护。关闭连接开关会停止专用连接和自动发现。

dsh-vscode-connect README · 开发与兼容：```powershell
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
```

Windows 可运行 `.\build.cmd` 构建并打包到 `artifacts/`。独立命令为 `npm run build`，然后创建 `artifacts/` 并运行 `npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination artifacts`。构建不需要旁边的扩展仓库。

后续同一内核系列更新可继续安装；构建依赖固定在已验证基线，新版完整交互仍需实际验证。

兼容声明以 `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 为准；声明的内核版本不等于全部现场交互均已验收。见[更新日志](CHANGELOG.md)、[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)和[生命周期检查记录](reviews/memory-lifecycle.md)。

dsh-vscode-connect README · DSH VS Code Connect：[简体中文](README.md) | English

Connect DeepSeek Harness / DSH Desktop to the companion [DSH Coding Agent](https://github.com/mcdottok/vscode-dsh) extension and continue the same conversation in your editor, with an experience similar to the Codex and Claude Code extensions for VS Code.

dsh-vscode-connect README · Demo：[](docs/assets/demo.mp4)

[Watch the demo video](docs/assets/demo.mp4)

dsh-vscode-connect README · Install and connect：Both plugins are required: **install this plugin in DeepSeek Harness / DSH Desktop and the companion extension in VS Code**.

In **DeepSeek Harness / DSH Desktop → Plugins → Add plugin**, enter the package name below and click **Install**. No manual download is needed:

```text
dsh-vscode-connect@latest
```

dsh-vscode-connect README · Install and connect：1. After installation, enable the plugin and keep Desktop running. New installations enable **VS Code connection** by default.
2. DSH Coding Agent has temporarily been removed from the VS Code Marketplace; the reason is not yet clear. We hope to republish it later. In the meantime, download the `.vsix` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mcdottok/vscode-dsh/releases), then select **Extensions: Install from VSIX...** in VS Code and choose the downloaded file. Open a trusted project folder and select **DSH Desktop** in the extension’s connection settings.
3. On Windows, the plugins discover and connect automatically on the same machine. Select the same workspace and existing session to continue development.

dsh-vscode-connect README · Install and connect：After downloading the VSIX, you can also install it from its directory using the command line (replace the filename with the downloaded version):

```powershell
code --install-extension ./dsh-coding-agent-0.1.83.vsix
```

For extension source code and issues, see the [vscode-dsh GitHub repository](https://github.com/mcdottok/vscode-dsh).

dsh-vscode-connect README · Install and connect：Browser access and a specific Desktop layout are not required. A previously saved disabled setting is respected; re-enable it under **Settings → General → VS Code connection**.

Available on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-vscode-connect). Alternatively, download a `.tgz` from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/mcdottok/dsh-vscode-connect/releases) and install the local file. If a registry mirror cannot find the package yet, select the official npm registry and retry.

dsh-vscode-connect README · Command-line installation from npm：For a DSH Web / CLI installation, run:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-vscode-connect@latest
```

For Desktop's `desktop` profile, run this with **the CLI bundled with that Desktop installation**:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-vscode-connect@latest
```

dsh-vscode-connect README · Command-line installation from npm：When managing the `desktop` profile, `dsh` must refer to the target Desktop's bundled CLI. Do not use a global DSH command from another runtime version to modify Desktop's profile. Desktop users can also use the **Add plugin** entry described above.

The package is downloaded from npm; `dsh plugin` installs it into the selected profile and registers the plugin.

dsh-vscode-connect README · Connection notes：- This is the **Desktop companion plugin** for **DSH Coding Agent** in VS Code. Install both to connect to Desktop.
- A ready connection entry means Desktop can accept connections. Check the VS Code extension for the actual connection status.
- This plugin is not required when the VS Code extension runs an independent service using a locally installed npm `dsh` package. Opening the same session in that service and Desktop may prevent model changes or message sending because another instance holds the session. Release it in the other instance, use a new session, or connect to the original Desktop instead. Different sessions in the same workspace are not subject to this restriction.

dsh-vscode-connect README · Manual connection and controls：For other platforms, remote environments, or when automatic connection is unavailable, choose **Copy connection address** under **Settings → General → VS Code connection** in Desktop, then run **DSH: Connect to Desktop** in VS Code and paste the address. Existing manual connection settings take precedence over discovery. If recovery fails, check that Desktop, both plugins and the connection switch are enabled, then copy a fresh address and reconnect.

dsh-vscode-connect README · Manual connection and controls：The address contains credentials; do not share it. Automatic connection currently supports local Windows only, with credentials protected by Windows account encryption and VS Code SecretStorage. Turning the switch off stops dedicated connections and automatic discovery.

dsh-vscode-connect README · Development and compatibility：```powershell
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
```

On Windows, run `.\build.cmd` to build and package into `artifacts/`. Alternatively, run `npm run build`, create `artifacts/`, then run `npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination artifacts`. No sibling extension repository is required.

dsh-vscode-connect README · Development and compatibility：Later updates in the same kernel series are admitted without a separate release for every RC. Build dependencies remain pinned to the verified baseline; complete behavior on newer runtimes still needs validation.

See `engines.dsh` in `package.json` for declared runtime compatibility. A declared version does not imply full Desktop acceptance. See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md), [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [lifecycle checks](reviews/memory-lifecycle.md).
